SELECT COUNT (0) FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ASS_INFO WHERE 1=1
and AYEAR = ${bookYear}

SELECT TEM.ACCID as ACCID,TEM.ASSNAME as assName,TEM.AMONTH as aMonth,TEM.QCMD as qcmd,TEM.QCMC as qcmc,TEM.QMMD as qmmd,TEM.QMMC as qmmc,TEM.BQMC as bqmc,TEM.BQMD as bqmd, TEM.LJMD as ljmd,TEM.LJMC as ljmc,TEM.QCDC as qcdc,TEM.QMDC as qmdc,TEM.ASSTYPE as assType,TEM.ACCNAME1||'--'||AB.ACCNAME1 as accName, TEM.ASSID AS ASSID,TEM.ACID FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT S.AYEAR,SUBSTR(S.ACCID,0,4) ACCID,S.ASSNAME,S.AMONTH,NVL(SUM(S.QCMD),'0') AS QCMD, NVL(SUM(S.QCMC),'0') AS QCMC,NVL(SUM(S.QMMD),'0') AS QMMD,NVL(SUM(S.QMMC),'0') AS QMMC,NVL(SUM(S.LJMD),'0') AS LJMD,NVL(SUM(S.BQMD),'0') AS BQMD,NVL(SUM(S.BQMC),'0') AS BQMC, NVL(SUM(S.LJMC),'0') AS LJMC,NVL(S.QCDC,'0') AS QCDC,NVL(S.QMDC,'0') AS QMDC,S.ASSTYPE,S.ASSID, AC.ACCNAME1,MIN(S.ACCID) AS ACID FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ASS_SUM S LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACCOUNT AC ON AC.ACCID = SUBSTR(S.ACCID,0,4) AND AC.AYEAR = S.AYEAR WHERE ASSNAME IS NOT NULL AND (QCMD != 0 OR QCMC != 0 OR QMMD != 0 OR QMMC != 0 OR LJMD != 0 OR LJMC != 0)
GROUP BY S.AYEAR,S.ASSNAME,S.AMONTH,S.ASSTYPE,S.ASSID,S.QCDC,S.QMDC,AC.ACCNAME1,SUBSTR(S.ACCID,0,4) ORDER BY ACCID ) TEM LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACCOUNT AB ON AB.ACCID = TEM.ACID AND AB.AYEAR = TEM.AYEAR ORDER BY TEM.ACCID ASC,TEM.ASSID ASC,TEM.AMONTH ASC

SELECT COUNT(0) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT S.AYEAR,SUBSTR(S.ACCID,0,4) ACCID,S.ASSNAME,S.AMONTH,NVL(SUM(S.QCMD),'0') AS QCMD, NVL(SUM(S.QCMC),'0') AS QCMC,NVL(SUM(S.QMMD),'0') AS QMMD,NVL(SUM(S.QMMC),'0') AS QMMC,NVL(SUM(S.LJMD),'0') AS LJMD, NVL(SUM(S.LJMC),'0') AS LJMC,NVL(S.QCDC,'0') AS QCDC,NVL(S.QMDC,'0') AS QMDC,S.ASSTYPE,S.ASSID, AC.ACCNAME1,MIN(S.ACCID) AS ACID FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ASS_SUM S LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACCOUNT AC ON AC.ACCID = SUBSTR(S.ACCID,0,4) AND AC.AYEAR = S.AYEAR WHERE ASSNAME IS NOT NULL AND (QCMD != 0 OR QCMC != 0 OR QMMD != 0 OR QMMC != 0 OR LJMD != 0 OR LJMC != 0)
GROUP BY S.AYEAR,S.ASSNAME,S.AMONTH,S.ASSTYPE,S.ASSID,S.QCDC,S.QMDC,AC.ACCNAME1,SUBSTR(S.ACCID,0,4) ORDER BY ACCID ) TEM LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACCOUNT AB ON AB.ACCID = TEM.ACID AND AB.AYEAR = TEM.AYEAR
SELECT ASSTYPE, ASSID, ASSNAME, ASSDES, ASSLEVEL, ASSSJBM FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ASS_INFO WHERE AYEAR = ${year} AND ASSID IN ${sqlStr} order by ASSTYPE,ASSID ASC

SELECT B.ASSID as assId,B.ASSNAME as assName,B.ASSTYPE as assType,NVL(B.QCMD,'0') AS qcmd,NVL(B.QCMC,'0') AS qcmc, NVL(B.BQMD,'0') AS bqmd,NVL(B.BQMC,'0') AS bqmc,NVL(B.QMMD,'0') AS qmmd, NVL(B.QMMC,'0') AS qmmc,B.QCDC as qcdc,B.QMDC as qmdc ,B.AID AS aid FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ASS_BAL B WHERE AYEAR = ${year} AND B.AID IN ${sqlStr} ORDER BY B.ASSID,B.ASSNAME

SELECT TEM.ACCID as ACCID,TEM.ASSNAME as assName,TEM.AMONTH as aMonth,TEM.QCMD as qcmd,TEM.QCMC as qcmc,TEM.QMMD as qmmd,TEM.QMMC as qmmc, TEM.LJMD as ljmd,TEM.LJMC as ljmc,TEM.QCDC as qcdc,TEM.QMDC as qmdc,TEM.ASSTYPE as assType,TEM.ACCNAME1||'--'||AB.ACCNAME1 as accName, TEM.ASSID AS ASSID,TEM.ACID FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT S.AYEAR,SUBSTR(S.ACCID,0,4) ACCID,S.ASSNAME,S.AMONTH,NVL(SUM(S.QCMD),'0') AS QCMD, NVL(SUM(S.QCMC),'0') AS QCMC,NVL(SUM(S.QMMD),'0') AS QMMD,NVL(SUM(S.QMMC),'0') AS QMMC,NVL(SUM(S.LJMD),'0') AS LJMD, NVL(SUM(S.LJMC),'0') AS LJMC,NVL(S.QCDC,'0') AS QCDC,NVL(S.QMDC,'0') AS QMDC,S.ASSTYPE,S.ASSID, AC.ACCNAME1,MIN(S.ACCID) AS ACID FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ASS_SUM S LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACCOUNT AC ON AC.ACCID = SUBSTR(S.ACCID,0,4) AND AC.AYEAR = S.AYEAR WHERE ASSNAME IS NOT NULL AND (QCMD != 0 OR QCMC != 0 OR QMMD != 0 OR QMMC != 0 OR LJMD != 0 OR LJMC != 0) AND S.AYEAR = #{year} AND ${sqlStr} GROUP BY S.AYEAR,S.ASSNAME,S.AMONTH,S.ASSTYPE,S.ASSID,S.QCDC,S.QMDC,AC.ACCNAME1,SUBSTR(S.ACCID,0,4) ORDER BY ACCID ) TEM LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACCOUNT AB ON AB.ACCID = TEM.ACID AND AB.AYEAR = TEM.AYEAR ORDER BY TEM.ACCID
